description: Move an object to a position with an acceleration and deceleration.

speed.name: Speed
speed.desc: The new speed of the object to set, in pixels per second.

acceleration.desc: The new acceleration of the object to set, in pixels per second per second. Use 0 for instant acceleration.

deceleration.desc: The new deceleration of the object to set, in pixels per second per second. Use 0 for instant deceleration.

actions.description: Set the turn speed for rotating towards the target position.

rotate-speed.name: Rotate speed
rotate-speed.desc: The turn speed to set, in degrees per second. Use 0 to disable turning.
